title: Voice vocabulary and quick chips, built

steps.path: Chat → right-click the microphone → Voice vocabulary
steps.headline: Voice vocabulary, as you picked: one card like Tags, Enter adds, saves as you go.
steps.changed: Tag-sized chips, "Add a word" over one box ("…then press Enter"), the explanation in grey under it. No Save button or status line: each word saves the moment it's added or removed. An empty list says "No words yet."
steps.notice: Closing the popup can no longer lose a change.
steps.risk: A removed word is saved as removed at once; add it again to undo.

steps.headline: Quick chips, as you picked: tag-shaped chips, plus your two fixes.
steps.changed: Chips are tag-shaped. The pencil on each chip now always shows, so there's no empty gap on the right. Adding is an "Add a chip" box like Tags and Voice: type a name, press Enter, and the add page opens with the name filled in. The how-to line sits under that box, as Voice's does.
steps.notice: The dashed "+ Add a chip" chip is gone; the box replaces it.
steps.risk: The pencil is always visible, so the chips are a little busier than before.
